title: Axe (DS)

{{Item |image=[[File:Axe (FoMT).png]] |name=Axe |obtain by=Starting Tool }} The '''Axe''' is an essential tool in [[Harvest Moon DS]], which is available in the inventory immediately. It is used to chop up branches, tree stumps, and [[Crops (DS)|fruit trees]] to obtain Lumber. ==Upgrades== {|border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="width:500px;text-align:center;" ! style="width:10%;background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112);"|Type ! style="width:10%;background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112);"|Strength ! style="width:10%;background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112);"|Stamina Usage ! style="width:10%;background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112);"|Description |- | [[File:Axe (FoMT).png]]
Axe | Can only cut branches. | 2 | Cuts branches for lumber. Won't cut trees or stumps. |- | [[File:Copper Axe (FoMT).png]]
Copper Axe | Breaks stumps in 6 strikes. Cannot chop trees. | 4 | rowspan=3 | Cuts branches and stumps for lumber. Won't cut trees. |- | [[File:Silver Axe (FoMT).png]]
Silver Axe | Breaks stumps in 3 strikes. Cannot crop trees. | 5 |- | [[File:Gold Axe (FoMT).png]]
Gold Axe | Breaks stumps in 2 strikes. Cannot chop trees. | 8 |- | [[File:Mystrile Axe (FoMT).png]]
